name: First Aid
description: What to do in an emergency, step by step and offline: CPR with a rhythm guide, choking, bleeding, burns, stroke and more.
prompt: An offline first aid guide with a big emergency call button and the number for your region, step-by-step cards for CPR with a 110 bpm metronome, choking, heavy bleeding, stroke, severe allergy, seizures, burns, fainting, heatstroke, nosebleeds, sprains and poisoning, each with what not to do.
author: gonzaroman
